I didn't think we'd ever see you again!''"
"''I promised we'd come back if we could.''"
"''I just wish… I wish ''Anakin'' were here too.|Melee and Kitster Banai|}} '''Melee''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] who lived in the [[spaceport]] [[Mos Espa]] on her [[homeworld]] [[Tatooine]] as a [[Youngling|child]]. In [[32 BBY]], she visited the [[Slavery|enslaved]] child [[Anakin Skywalker]] with several other children as he was working on a [[Anakin Skywalker's Podracer|podracer]] that he planned to enter into the [[Boonta Eve Classic]] race. Melee and her companions [[Amee]], [[Wald]], and [[Seek]] expressed doubts about the [[Podracer|vehicle]] and then left Skywalker. By between [[3 ABY]] and [[4 ABY]], Melee was enslaved and worked with Seek and Amee on a [[Unidentified moisture farm|moisture farm]] until Wald and [[Kitster Banai]], another childhood friend, bought their freedom. The group then reminisced about Skywalker around a [[fire]] until they were confronted by a group of [[Thief|thieves]] who aimed to steal [[Energy capsule (technology)|energy capsules]] from Wald and Banai. The pair handed the capsules over when [[Unidentified thief (Tatooine)|one]] of the thieves threatened Melee with a [[blaster]], but the criminals were then [[Death|slain]] by the [[Sith assassin|assassin]] [[Ochi|Ochi of Bestoon]], who took the capsules and left. ==Biography== ===The children of Mos Espa=== {{Quote|You've been working on that thing for years.''"
"''It's never gonna run.|Amee and Melee, referring to Anakin Skywalker's podracer|audio=Amee-Melee.flac|}} [[File:AnakinAndFriends-TPM.png|thumb|left|300px|Melee was not impressed by Anakin Skywalker's podracer.]] Melee was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] who was [[Reproduction|born]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]]. As a [[Youngling|young]] girl, she followed the [[Slavery|enslaved]] child [[Anakin Skywalker]] around, and in [[32 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|I}} to [[32 BBY]]. she and several other children visited Skywalker in [[Slave Quarters Row]] in the [[spaceport]] [[Mos Espa]].[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']] He was working on his [[Anakin Skywalker's Podracer|podracer]] in a courtyard and announced that he was taking part in the [[Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing|podrace]] the next [[Standard day|day]]. Melee was dubious that Skywalker's [[podracer]] would even run, and the other children present expressed similar doubts. The boy [[Seek]] then suggested that they go and play a ball game, and Melee left with him, [[Wald]], and [[Amee]], leaving only [[Kitster Banai]] behind with Skywalker. The latter ultimately won the race and left Tatooine to become a [[Jedi]]. Wald and Banai were eventually rescued from slavery on Tatooine by the [[Naboo (people)|Naboo]] agents [[Sabé]] and [[Tonra]], who also saw them offworld;[[Darth Vader (2020) 23|''Darth Vader'' (2020) 23]] however, before leaving, Banai promised Melee, Amee, and Seek, who remained on the planet, that he would return if he could. ===Reunion=== {{Dialogue|Seek|Anakin… really was ''special'', wasn't he?|Amee|Yeah. Like no one else.|Melee|Sometimes I wonder… how it would have gone if he'd been here to ''protect'' us all along.|attr=Seek, Amee, and Melee discuss Anakin Skywalker|src=}} [[File:AnakinFriendsReunion-2020DarthVader50.png|thumb|right|300px|Melee, Seek, and Amee were freed from enslavement by their friends Kitster Banai and Wald.]] By between [[3 ABY]] and [[4 ABY]],{{SW|url=news/swce-2023-marvel|text=SWCE 2023: Marvel Reveals ''Star Wars: Dark Droids'' Horror Event and More}} states that the events of the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series [[Star Wars: Darth Vader (2020)|''Star Wars: Darth Vader'']], including [[Darth Vader (2020) 50|''Darth Vader'' (2020) 50]], take place between the events of {{Film|V}} and {{Film|VI}}, which are dated to [[3 ABY]] and [[4 ABY]], respectively, by ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''. Melee was enslaved with Amee and Seek on a [[Unidentified moisture farm|moisture farm]] on Tatooine. Banai and Wald then returned to Tatooine and, after selling an [[Energy capsule (technology)|energy capsule]] that they had stolen from the [[Galactic Empire]], they gave the [[Currency|money]] from the sale to the [[Unidentified moisture farmer enslaver|owner]] of the [[farm]] to free all the enslaved workers there. They then sought out their old friends, who were surprised and overjoyed to see them, although Melee wished Skywalker was with them as well. Later that [[Local day|night]], the group sat together around a [[fire]] and shared tales about Skywalker, with Banai also telling Melee and the others about his and Wald's encounter with the [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]] Darth Vader, who had saved the pair on three occasions. Banai and Wald also revealed that they had tried to find Skywalker after leaving Tatooine until the [[Jedi Order]] was [[Order 66|destroyed]], but Melee disputed that anyone could have bested their absent friend and claimed to know he was still out there somewhere. Banai suggested that they find out where but was interrupted by a shot in the shoulder from a group of [[Thief|thieves]] who descended upon Melee and her friends. ===An unlikely savior=== {{Quote|Who… who's ''that''?''"
"''That was ''Ochi''. He works for ''Vader''. The ''killer'' we told you about.''"
"''I… I wish… I wish ''Anakin'' were here.|Melee and Kitster Banai|}} [[File:KitsterShot-2020DarthVader50.png|thumb|left|300px|Melee and her friends were threatened by a group of thieves.]] The [[Unidentified thief (Tatooine)|leader]] of the thieves revealed that they had [[Death|killed]] the [[Unidentified vendor (energy capsule)|vendor]] that Banai and Wald had sold an energy capsule to and come to claim the rest. When Banai claimed there were no other capsules, the leader threatened Melee with a [[blaster]], forcing Banai and Wald to reveal the remaining capsules they had. The thieves took the capsules but were then cut down by the [[Sith assassin]] [[Ochi|Ochi of Bestoon]], who had been sent by Vader to reclaim the capsules. The [[assassin]] took the capsules and acknowledged Banai and Wald, then left without harming them. When Melee asked about their mysterious savior, Banai explained that Ochi worked for Vader, prompting Melee to once again wish that Skywalker was with them. Ochi returned the capsules to Vader and informed him that Banai and the others had had them but that he had let them live, questioning if he should return to kill them. Vader, who was in fact Melee's childhood friend Anakin Skywalker turned to the [[Dark side of the Force|dark side]], told the assassin to leave them be. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|I can't believe anyone would ever get one over on Anakin. He's out there. I ''know'' it.|Melee|}} [[File:AnakinAndFriends-2020DarthVader50.png|thumb|right|300px|Melee followed Anakin Skywalker as a child and believed he was special as an adult.]] Although she doubted that his podracer would work as a child, Melee believed Skywalker was special and wondered how her life would have differed if he had stayed on Tatooine and protected her. Despite the [[Great Jedi Purge|downfall]] of the Jedi Order he had joined, she doubted anyone could have bested him and so believed that he was still alive by the [[time]] she was freed from enslavement, wishing on multiple occasions he could have been there with her and her friends. Melee had [[Color|brown]] [[eye]]s, light skin, and brown [[hair]] she wore tied up in three bunches as both a child and an adult. ==Equipment== As a child, Melee wore a dark red [[Clothing|dress]] when meeting Skywalker. When freed from enslavement, she wore a similarly colored dress over a white shirt with a brown [[belt]]. ==Behind the scenes== Melee was portrayed by [[Megan Udall]] in the character's first appearance in the [[1999]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']]. Her name was not stated in the film but was given in the credits. Udall is the daughter of [[Jeanie Udall]], the unit nurse for the film.{{SW|url=news/star-wars-a-family-affair|text=''Star Wars'', A Family Affair|nolive=1}} In the film's script, Melee is not mentioned and Amee says her line instead.[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Insider's Guide'']] The scene in which Melee appears was filmed in [[Tunisia]].{{WebCite|url=http://www.theforce.net/episode1/story/article_on_oliver_walpole_79549.asp|text=Article on Oliver Walpole|author=Scott|date=1999-07-13|work=[[TheForce.net]]|archiveurl=https://archive.is/qlFdP|archivedate=2021-05-24}} ==Appearances== {{Indexpage}} {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Melee}} *{{Film|I}} {{1st}} *[[Darth Vader (2020) 26|''Darth Vader'' (2020) 26]] {{Flash}} *[[Darth Vader (2020) 50|''Darth Vader'' (2020) 50]] ==Sources== *{{SW|url=news/star-wars-a-family-affair|text=''Star Wars'', A Family Affair|nolive=1}} *{{Topps|set=2016 Topps Star Wars: Rogue One Mission Briefing|cardname=Megan Udall|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/137403/cid/11208730/2016-Topps-Star-Wars-Rogue-One-Mission-Briefing---Autographs-NNO-Megan-Udall}} *{{Topps|set=2017 Topps Star Wars Galactic Files Reborn|cardname=Megan Udall|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/155209/cid/11245801/2017-Topps-Star-Wars-Galactic-Files:-Reborn---Autographs-NNO-Megan-Udall}} *''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A -
